Patient:  
Doctor: Also, is the finger/shoulder pain accompanied by numbness, tingling, weakness, or a rash—any swelling/redness around the painful areas?
I don’t know. I also have no rash swelling (0/10) and no pain caused by the rash (0/10), and the rash itching severity is 0.
